# TRF Industrial Automation

> TRF Industrial Automation designs, builds and installs robotic palletizing, case packing and conveyor systems for food, beverage, CPG and other production lines across the United States. Keep your production running.

Serving the United States from 14840 W 107th St, Lenexa, KS 66215, United States. Phone (913) 242-8019.

## Home and solution hubs

- [Case Packing Equipment That Adapts to High-Mix Lines, Difficult Products and Repetitive Flexible Packages](https://trfautomation.com/case-packing.md): Case packing equipment for food and CPG lines: compare TRFRapidpack, TRFOnepack and TRFDroppack, from vision-guided robotic to gravity packing.
- [Industrial Conveyor Systems Engineered to Connect Packaging and Food Processing Lines](https://trfautomation.com/conveyor-systems.md): Industrial conveyor systems from TRF Industrial Automation: TRFIntraflow for cases, TRFCleanflow for washdown food lines. Talk with our Sales Engineer.
- [End-of-Line Automation Engineered to Keep Your Production Running.](https://trfautomation.com/index.md): TRF Industrial Automation designs, installs and supports robotic palletizing, case packing and conveyors in the United States. Talk to a Sales Engineer.
- [Robotic Palletizing Systems Engineered for Food, Beverage and CPG Production Lines](https://trfautomation.com/robotic-palletizing.md): Compare TRFCobot, TRFCompact, TRFSpeed, TRFSubzero and custom palletizers for food, beverage and CPG lines. Talk with our Sales Engineer.

## Robotic palletizing

- [Bag Palletizer Sized to Your Bag Weight and Line Rate.](https://trfautomation.com/robotic-palletizing/bag-palletizer.md): Bag palletizer systems from TRF Industrial Automation: TRFCobot, TRFCompact, TRFSpeed or a custom palletizer, sized to your bag weight and line rate.
- [Box Palletizer Sized to Your Box Mix and Line Rate.](https://trfautomation.com/robotic-palletizing/box-palletizer.md): Box palletizer systems from TRF Industrial Automation stack corrugated boxes for distribution, co-packers and CPG lines, sized to your rate and space.
- [Pail Palletizer and Bucket Palletizer Sized to Your Line.](https://trfautomation.com/robotic-palletizing/bucket-palletizer.md): Robotic pail palletizer from TRF: TRFCobot, TRFCompact, TRFSpeed or custom, evaluated per application. Talk with our Sales Engineer.
- [Bundle Palletizer Sized to Your Bundles and Line Rate.](https://trfautomation.com/robotic-palletizing/bundle-palletizer.md): Bundle palletizer systems from TRF Industrial Automation for shrink-wrapped multipacks and paper bundles: TRFCobot, TRFCompact, TRFSpeed or custom.
- [Carton Palletizer Sized to Your Cartons and Line Rate.](https://trfautomation.com/robotic-palletizing/carton-palletizer.md): Carton palletizer systems from TRF Industrial Automation: stable, square loads with TRFCobot, TRFCompact, TRFSpeed or custom, sized to your line.
- [Case Palletizer Sized to Your Case Packer Output.](https://trfautomation.com/robotic-palletizing/case-palletizer.md): Case palletizer systems from TRF Industrial Automation stack sealed cases from your case packer: TRFCobot, TRFCompact, TRFSpeed or custom.
- [TRFCobot Is the Cobot Palletizer Built for Short Runs and Frequent SKU Changes.](https://trfautomation.com/robotic-palletizing/cobot-palletizer.md): TRFCobot is a cobot palletizer for short runs, frequent SKU changes and tight floor space, about 1 to 10 cases per minute. Talk with our Sales Engineer.
- [TRFCompact Fits a Robotic Case Palletizer Into the Footprint of a Brownfield Line.](https://trfautomation.com/robotic-palletizing/compact-palletizer.md): TRFCompact is a compact robotic case palletizer for brownfield plants and secondary lines, about 5 to 15 cases per minute. Talk with our Sales Engineer.
- [Custom Palletizing Systems, Engineered Around Your Line.](https://trfautomation.com/robotic-palletizing/custom-palletizer.md): Custom palletizing systems engineered around your products, layout and throughput when no standard platform fits. Talk with our Sales Engineer.
- [Drum Palletizer Evaluated by Drum Weight and Line Rate.](https://trfautomation.com/robotic-palletizing/drum-palletizer.md): Drum palletizer systems from TRF Industrial Automation: TRFCobot, TRFCompact, TRFSpeed or a custom palletizer, evaluated per application.
- [TRFSpeed Is a High-Speed Palletizing System Engineered for Multi-Line, 24/7 Production.](https://trfautomation.com/robotic-palletizing/high-speed-palletizer.md): TRFSpeed is a high-speed palletizing system for multi-line, 24/7 production, about 10 to 35 cases per minute. Talk with our Sales Engineer.
- [Robotic Palletizer Cost: What Drives the Price, From Entry-Level Cobots to High-Speed Multi-Line Systems.](https://trfautomation.com/robotic-palletizing/robotic-palletizer-cost.md): What does a robotic palletizer cost? See list prices, price drivers and how payback is estimated, then calculate your ROI. Talk with our Sales Engineer.
- [TRFSubzero Is the Subzero Palletizer Built for Production Below 32°F.](https://trfautomation.com/robotic-palletizing/subzero-palletizer.md): TRFSubzero is a subzero palletizer for frozen food, ice cream and frozen meat lines below 32°F. Talk with our Sales Engineer.
- [Tray Palletizer Sized to Your Line and Tray Weight.](https://trfautomation.com/robotic-palletizing/tray-palletizer.md): Tray palletizer systems from TRF Industrial Automation stack loaded trays for bakery, dairy, protein and frozen food lines, sized to your rate.

## Case packing

- [Bag Case Packers Matched to Your Line Speed.](https://trfautomation.com/case-packing/bag-case-packer.md): TRF bag case packers load VFFS, IQF, pet food and grated cheese bags into cases with TRFDroppack, TRFRapidpack or TRFOnepack, matched to your line.
- [Carton Packing Machine Sized to Your Line.](https://trfautomation.com/case-packing/carton-case-packer.md): Carton packing machine for loading finished cartons into shipping cases: TRFRapidpack robotic packing or TRFOnepack to erect, pack and seal.
- [Cup and Tub Case Packer Matched to Your Line.](https://trfautomation.com/case-packing/cup-and-tub-case-packer.md): TRF cup and tub case packers load sealed cups and tubs into shipping cases with TRFRapidpack or TRFOnepack, chosen by your line setup and speed.
- [TRFDroppack Is the Gravity Drop Packer for Flexible Packages, Simple by Design.](https://trfautomation.com/case-packing/drop-packer.md): TRFDroppack is a gravity drop packer for flexible bags, pouches and IQF products, with no robotic tooling to maintain. Talk with our Sales Engineer.
- [Flow Wrap Case Packer for Fast Flow Pack Lines.](https://trfautomation.com/case-packing/flow-wrap-case-packer.md): TRF flow wrap case packers load flow packs into cases with TRFRapidpack robotic top-load packing, plus TRFOnepack or TRFDroppack when your line fits.
- [TRFOnepack Is a Case Packing Machine That Erects, Packs and Seals on One Platform.](https://trfautomation.com/case-packing/integrated-case-packer.md): TRFOnepack is a case packing machine that erects, packs and seals cases in one integrated system for food and CPG lines. Talk with our Sales Engineer.
- [Pillow Bag Case Packer Sized to Your Line.](https://trfautomation.com/case-packing/pillow-bag-case-packer.md): TRF pillow bag case packers load pillow bags into cases with TRFRapidpack, TRFOnepack or TRFDroppack, chosen by your line setup and speed.
- [Pouch Case Packer for Robotic or Gravity Loading.](https://trfautomation.com/case-packing/pouch-case-packer.md): TRF pouch case packers load pouches into cases with TRFRapidpack robotic packing or TRFDroppack gravity loading, chosen by line setup and speed.
- [TRFRapidpack Is the Robotic Case Packer Built Around Your Product.](https://trfautomation.com/case-packing/robotic-case-packer.md): TRFRapidpack is a robotic case packer for high-mix lines, with delta robots and vision-guided or indexed picking. Talk with our Sales Engineer.
- [Thermoformed Package Case Packer Built Around Your Packs.](https://trfautomation.com/case-packing/thermoformed-package-case-packer.md): Thermoformed package case packer for sealed food packs: TRFRapidpack robotic packing or TRFOnepack to erect, pack and seal, sized to line speed.
- [Top Load Case Packers Matched to Your Line Speed.](https://trfautomation.com/case-packing/top-load-case-packer.md): Top load case packer guide: compare TRFRapidpack robotic, TRFOnepack erect-pack-seal and TRFDroppack gravity loading by line setup and speed.
- [Tray Packer for Robotic or Integrated Case Packing.](https://trfautomation.com/case-packing/tray-packer.md): TRF tray packers load trays into shipping cases with TRFRapidpack for high-mix lines or TRFOnepack to erect, pack and seal cases in one machine.

## Conveyor systems

- [Accumulation Conveyor Systems for Balanced Lines.](https://trfautomation.com/conveyor-systems/accumulation-and-flow-control.md): Accumulation conveyor systems from TRF buffer, meter and space cases between packaging, case packing and palletizing. Talk with our Sales Engineer.
- [TRFIntraflow custom conveyor systems are engineered to move and built to last.](https://trfautomation.com/conveyor-systems/case-conveyor-intralogistics.md): TRFIntraflow builds custom conveyor systems for case, carton and tote intralogistics, linking packaging to palletizing. Talk with our Sales Engineer.
- [Conveyor Curves and Transfers, Engineered Into the Line.](https://trfautomation.com/conveyor-systems/curves-and-transfers.md): Conveyor curves and transfers from TRF: 90 degree transfers, curves, turntables and pop-up transfers in one line. Talk with our Sales Engineer.
- [Elevation Conveyors for Multi-Level Case Flow.](https://trfautomation.com/conveyor-systems/elevation-conveyors.md): Elevation conveyors from TRF move cases between floors and levels: incline, decline, elevator, lowerator, vertical transfer. Talk with our Sales Engineer.
- [End-of-Line Automation: One Partner, One Line.](https://trfautomation.com/conveyor-systems/end-of-line-integration.md): TRF engineers end-of-line automation as one system: case packing, palletizing and conveying designed, installed and supported by a single partner.
- [TRFCleanflow Dry Conveyor System: Sanitary Conveying for Dry Zones.](https://trfautomation.com/conveyor-systems/hygienic-food-conveyor/dry.md): TRFCleanflow Dry is a dry conveyor system for low-moisture food zones, with an open frame and easy vacuum access. Talk with our Sales Engineer.
- [TRFCleanflow Washdown: The Washdown Conveyor Built for High-Pressure Cleaning.](https://trfautomation.com/conveyor-systems/hygienic-food-conveyor/washdown.md): TRFCleanflow Washdown is a washdown conveyor for food-contact zones cleaned daily at high pressure and temperature. Talk with our Sales Engineer.
- [TRFCleanflow Sanitary Conveyor Systems Are Clean by Design and Robust by Nature.](https://trfautomation.com/conveyor-systems/hygienic-food-conveyor.md): TRFCleanflow sanitary conveyor systems move exposed food through processing and packaging in Dry or Washdown lines. Talk with our Sales Engineer.
- [Merge and Divert Conveyors for Case Routing.](https://trfautomation.com/conveyor-systems/merge-divert-and-sorting.md): Merge and divert conveyors from TRF route cases from several lines to the right palletizer or lane, with sorting and reject. Talk with our Sales Engineer.
- [Straight Conveying Systems for Case Handling Lines.](https://trfautomation.com/conveyor-systems/straight-conveying.md): Straight conveying systems in powered roller, belt and modular belt, engineered by TRF into one case handling line. Talk with our Sales Engineer.
- [Industrial Conveyor Systems Engineered to Connect Packaging and Food Processing Lines](https://trfautomation.com/conveyor-systems.md): Industrial conveyor systems from TRF Industrial Automation: TRFIntraflow for cases, TRFCleanflow for washdown food lines. Talk with our Sales Engineer.
